tagline: Modern batik and woven-textile profile for buyer and Google Review discovery.

story.title: Modern batik and woven-textile profile for buyer and Google Review discovery.
story.body: ELLETA dipetakan sebagai wastra batik dan tenun modern. Dua kanal Instagram dari handover dipasang, sementara Google Review/Maps menunggu link lokasi langsung dari pemilik agar tidak salah bisnis.

highlights.title: Buyer discovery
highlights.body: A concise profile for retail, boutique, gifting and buyer introductions.

highlights.title: Local identity
highlights.body: The page keeps the Tangsel origin visible without inventing unverified heritage claims.

highlights.title: Direct channels
highlights.body: Only channels supplied by the handover or public sources are published.

highlights.title: NFC ready
highlights.body: Mobile-first layout with large tap targets for exhibition use.

verification.note: Official social handles are taken from the 2026 TEI project handover. Public web search did not provide enough independent evidence to upgrade the full business profile to public-source-checked.
